prompt:
A real photograph, taken with a good phone camera and looking exactly like a phone photograph, of a nurse talking with an old man in a hospital bed while a young interpreter translates, in a wide horizontal picture, everything in sharp focus. Natural colours, soft daylight from the window. The textures of real cotton, wool, plastic, steel, skin and hair, with the true depth and the slight lens perspective of a photograph.

The second reference picture is a real phone photograph taken on the same hospital ward: use it for the photographic look; the room has the same warm white walls and the same pale grey vinyl floor as in that photograph.

AN OLD MAN of about seventy-five, with grey hair and a grey moustache, in a light-blue hospital gown, sits propped up in a hospital bed on the right of the picture, his eyes on the young woman.

A YOUNG WOMAN of about twenty-five, the interpreter, with long dark hair, in a beige jacket with a plain white card clipped to the lapel, sits on a chair beside the bed in the middle of the picture, turned towards the old man, speaking.

JONAS, a German senior nurse of thirty-eight. The second reference picture shows Jonas: his face, hair and build stay exactly as in it. He wears a plain white short-sleeved nurse's tunic, plain white trousers and white trainers, a pair of trauma scissors and a black pen in the breast pocket. He stands at the foot of the bed on the left of the picture, a clipboard with a blank sheet in his hand, his eyes on the old man.

The whole picture carries no writing, numbers, print, symbol or logo anywhere: the clothes have no name badge, no embroidery and no brand, every paper is blank or carries only grey lines and empty boxes, and every screen shows only plain pale-blue panels.
